name: web-a11y
description: Playwright-based accessibility audit reports for web application URLs across React, Next.js, Spring/Thymeleaf, and static HTML.

interface.shortDescription: Audit web URLs and produce accessibility reports
interface.longDescription: Run Playwright and axe-core accessibility audits against rendered web URLs and produce JSON plus Markdown reports with violations, incomplete review items, selectors, and impact metadata.
defaultPrompt: Run an accessibility audit for this URL.
Audit these web pages and write JSON and Markdown reports.
Summarize the latest Playwright accessibility audit report.
